limitations: Superior petrosal geometry retained: open walls, multiple components, degenerate faces and existing arterial contacts require a coupled regional repair.
Inferior petrosal open walls, existing bone contacts and left/right 3/1 self-intersections remain. Local fitting is not exact groove or lumen acceptance.
Ten companion additions retain closed individual surfaces, but separate receiving-volume overlaps do not certify a continuous merged lumen.
Cervical vertebrae and exact transverse foramina, canal/nerve/globe targets are absent or unsegmented; no invented targets or new branches.
G07 dural/canal containment, capped endpoints and full receiver closure remain. The left meningeal/emissary contact is cleared.
Twelve deferred arterial segments in three networks and G01/G03/G04/G05/G06 remain.
